title: Bi-Lipschitz invariance of the transverse polynomial along polar arcs
summary: We study transverse polynomials along polar arcs of reduced holomorphic plane function germs. We prove that, under bi-Lipschitz right equivalence, matched tangential polar arcs have the same transverse order and their transverse polynomials agree up to nonzero rescalings of the source and target, at every rational scale $1<q<d(γ)$, where $d(γ)$ is the gradient canyon degree. This range is sharp as the result can fail at both endpoints, even under analytic right equivalence.
